_instructions: Copy this file to simulation_runs/round_002_source_candidates/slice_<n>/SRC-0XX.manual_verification.json and fill it for ONE source. Do NOT edit the original SRC-0XX.json. Search snippets do NOT count as verification. Excerpts must be <= 25 words. See ROUND_2_MANUAL_SOURCE_VERIFICATION_WORKFLOW.md.
verifier_name_or_role: <name or role of the human who opened the source>
source_access_method: DIRECT_FETCH | EDGAR | OFFICIAL_PDF | NEWS_ARCHIVE | DATASET_DOWNLOAD | COURT_PORTAL | ARCHIVED_SNAPSHOT | OTHER

source_locator.type: SEC_FILING | PDF_REPORT | NEWS_ARTICLE | COURT_DOCKET | DATASET | TRANSCRIPT
source_locator.reference: <e.g. EDGAR accession 0000320193-22-000108 · 10-K · Item 8 · Consolidated Statements of Operations · p.31  (NEVER a bare homepage URL)>
source_locator.resolved_url_or_doc: <the exact URL/doc actually opened; archived-snapshot URL+timestamp if used>

verified_metrics.metric: <metric key, matching the candidate where possible>
verified_metrics.verified_value: <value as printed in the source, with unit>

verified_outcome_evidence.documented_outcome: <e.g. filed Chapter 11 on 2017-09-18 / emerged 2021-06-30 / shut down>
verified_outcome_evidence.locator: <where in the source the outcome is stated>

direct_quotes_or_short_excerpts: <<=25-word excerpt proving a critical figure is on the page>
inferred_facts: <verifier interpretation NOT stated verbatim in the source>
